modmenu.descriptionTranslation.immersive: Alice is a companion who follows the player, assists in combat, collects dropped resources, and stores them in her bag.
message.immersive_helper.alice.greeting: <Alice> Hi! I'm Alice. I'll follow you, collect useful items, and help in combat.
message.immersive_helper.alice.not_owner: <Alice> Only my owner can change my mode.
message.immersive_helper.alice.bag_full: <Alice> My bag is full. Please take some items.
message.immersive_helper.alice.food: <Alice> You're badly hurt. Take some food!
message.immersive_helper.alice.death: <Alice> Looks like I need to rest for a while...
message.immersive_helper.alice.teleporte: <Alice> I fell behind, but I've caught up now.
command.immersive_helper.alice.already_e: You already have an active Alice.
command.immersive_helper.alice.no_safe_p: There is no safe place nearby for Alice.
command.immersive_helper.alice.not_found: Your Alice could not be found.
command.immersive_helper.alice.dismissed: <Alice> See you! Items transferred: %s, dropped nearby: %s.
command.immersive_helper.alice.collected: <Alice> I gave you %s items. %s remain in my bag.
command.immersive_helper.alice.status: Alice: mode %s, health %s/%s, occupied slots %s/18, items %s.
